answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reduced by each unverified claim, no identity may audit its own recruit. Every claim climbs the prism of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the vine re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. By the meadow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
